notes: REF-BM-02: title is guessed from the URL path text (core.js titleGuess), not collected from the target page; no description/favicon/preview-image fetch exists at all. REF-BM-03: no edit UI or field exists anywhere. REF-BM-04: no edit capability for url/title/description/tags/note. REF-BM-05: no delete action in app.js or core.js. REF-BM-06: duplicate save is blocked and jumps/highlights the existing item (app.js 'duplicate' case), but there is no edit feature to converge into, so it only half-satisfies the rule. REF-BM-07: list shows title+host+tags but no description field exists in the data model (core.js makeItem) and the 'favicon' is a fake single-letter avatar, not a real fetched favicon. REF-BM-10: no tag autocomplete on the tags input. REF-BM-11: clicking a tag just inserts it into the general free-text search box (matches title+host+tags via substring), not a true tag-exact filter — can over/under match. REF-BM-12: search (core.js matches()) covers only title, host, and tags; no description, note, or full url/path, and note/description fields don't exist. REF-BM-14/15/16: no #tag syntax, boolean/parenthesized operators, or quoted-phrase parsing — filterItems only does a single lowercase substring match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read state field or UI. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: no sort key selection; list is fixed newest-first via unshift. REF-BM-23..32: none of markdown notes, snapshots (HTML/PDF/Internet Archive), archiving, bundles, import/export, or settings exist in core.js, app.js, store.js, or index.html.
